title: Add discriminating watcher coverage for a named source root under a parent build directory
outcome: A behavioral regression exercises collect_workspace_file_watch_scopes for a named/observed source root under target/ or node_modules/, distinguishing it from the parent workdir and sibling ignored paths.
acceptance: With workdir W and named root W/target/wt, the production watcher path publishes/attributes W/target/wt/src/x.rs.
W/target/wt/target/y and W/target/other/z remain ignored, so the test distinguishes named-root scope selection from blanket exemption.
